reciprocal.why: The kernel is practical wisdom applied to institutional decisions: listing affected groups and judging impacts from their point of view before acting.
The scan makes perspective-taking concrete in organizational settings by requiring one impact sentence per affected group, written from that group's side.
The scan widens institutional decision frames from efficiency or profit alone toward the good of the whole, with Freeman's stakeholder definition applied as routine.
The scan treats attention to affected parties, rather than only rules or contracts, as the starting point of an institutional decision.

notes: k1d kernels slice B. Whys are interpretive, not empirical causal claims; supervisor integration only. No existing backlinks on the four target pages at proposal time.
